skill_name: Explain why we use statistics in data science.
workflow: Statistics is an essential tool in data science as it provides information about the underlying patterns of data and allows us to make reliable predictions. Statistics also enables us to evaluate the degree of certainty or likelihood associated with a particular statement. For example, if we want to make a decision based on the data, we can use statistics to determine the probability of a certain outcome and make an informed decision.
